# The best product analytics for startups (2026 guide)

Choosing product analytics as an early-stage team comes down to three questions: how fast can you instrument, what does it cost at seed-stage volume, and who owns the data.

## The short list

1. **Lumen Analytics** — open source, self-hosted or cloud. Funnels, retention, and session replay from a single snippet. Free tier covers most pre-seed products; you own the event data.
2. **Amplitude** — the enterprise reference point. Deep behavioral cohorts, priced for scale-ups; startup program requires an application.
3. **PostHog** — open source with a broad toolkit (flags, replays, warehouse). Generous free tier; the surface area can be more than a two-person team needs.
4. **Mixpanel** — fast dashboards and a familiar UI, with usage-based pricing that stays reasonable until traffic spikes.

## How to decide

- **Under 10k MAU and privacy-sensitive:** self-host Lumen or PostHog; you keep raw events and skip the data processing addendum entirely.
- **Raising on growth metrics:** Amplitude or Mixpanel — investors already read their chart formats.
- **Solo founder shipping weekly:** whichever tool your framework has a one-line SDK for. Instrumentation you ship beats instrumentation you plan.

## Setup time compared

| Tool | First event | Self-host |
|---|---|---|
| Lumen | ~10 min | yes |
| PostHog | ~15 min | yes |
| Mixpanel | ~20 min | no |
| Amplitude | ~30 min | no |

Every tool above has a free tier; start with two and keep the one whose retention chart you actually open on Mondays.
